environment.description: Migration service deployed on EC2 in a public subnet with an internet-facing ALB. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The ALB forwards to port 8443 on the instance. No WAF rules attached. The service is temporarily exposed during the migration window for the remote migration orchestrator team to access.

config.tls: ALB terminates TLS, forwards HTTP to port 8443
config.authentication: None - relies on network controls only
